title: Two Crystals -- quick prototype
author: Brave-History-6502
selftext:
My son's friend (8yrs old) wanted to build a game. So I had him and his friends talk about a ton of random ideas... I recorded the conversation and then input it into claude to identify a few specific game ideas.

There were some really interesting 2 dimension/portal gameplay ideas around crystals that I thought was quite brilliant so we generated some concept art and rthen spent a hour or so building a "vertical slice" demo.

I used unity/blender and meshy with claude code running opus 5.5 delegating to haiku subagents. 

In addition, I use gpt image 2.5 to generate concept art to help drive visual clarity.

Just wanted to share this in case anyone else is building games for kiddos and wants some ideas for how to do it!
